create.name: Buddhify
create.bio:
Buddhify is a mindfulness app made by a small, self-funded family company in Glasgow, run by Rohan Gunatillake and Lucy Gunatillake. Rohan began meditating at university in 2003 and, after years of retreats and study alongside a career in technology, set out to adapt classical mindfulness techniques to busy city life. That idea of practice on the move, on a train, at a desk or out walking, is still the heart of the app, and Rohan has also written a book on the same theme, Modern Mindfulness.

The guided sessions sit on a wheel sorted by what you are doing at the time, such as walking, travelling, a work break, waking up or eating, and run from a few minutes to about half an hour. They are written and voiced by a group of chosen teachers. Alongside them are short lessons on the principles of meditation, an unguided solo timer, practices meant for two people or a group, and a separate set of sessions for children. An optional yearly membership adds a wheel of formal technique training, weekly video material and a feature that lets members read meditations aloud to others in their own voice.

courses.title: Buddhify Membership
courses.description: An optional yearly membership bought inside the app. It adds a wheel of eighteen sessions that teach six core formal meditation techniques as short courses, weekly video courses and practice themes, and a read-aloud feature for sharing meditations in your own voice.
